home.seo_desc: Building fast, secure, and user-friendly mobile and web applications.
home.hero_subtitle: We build Android apps and websites for everyday things — checking card balances, reading QRIS codes, finding a Quran verse from its recitation, tracing where a forwarded hadith comes from, following along at a tahlil. Built at home, used at home, passed on to whoever needs them.
home.hero_signature: do code for fun, no.. serious things.
home.origin_p1: A baskom is the enamel basin in every Indonesian kitchen — green marbled splash, white inside, dark blue rolled rim. Cheap, dented, immortal. Nobody treats a baskom as something precious, and that is exactly the point. Everything gets mixed in it: dough, rujak, laundry, coconut ice for the neighbourhood feast.
home.origin_p2: Ours just happens to be full of code. Ideas go in, get stirred, and come out as apps — built at home, used at home, passed on to whoever needs them. No ceremony.
home.dev_profile_desc: All BaskomLabs apps in one place.
home.qrstu_desc: Scan a QRIS code, unpack what is inside it, and learn how it works.
home.pembacakue_desc: Check eMoney, Flazz, and other NFC card balances straight from your phone.
home.yasintahlil_desc: Yasin, Tahlil, Maulid & Sholawat in full — works without an internet connection.
home.nfc_desc: We tinker with NFC to connect cards and phones safely — from reading an eMoney balance to understanding the conversation between a card and a reader. That is what PembacaKUE is made of.
home.contact_desc: Want to talk about a project, found a bug in one of our apps, or just curious about something? Say hello.
home.apps_title: Small apps and websites for everyday things.
home.qris_desc: One QR code carries a lot of data: merchant name, city, even the amount. QRSTU unpacks that structure so it is easy to read and learn from.
home.offline_desc: Yasin, Tahlil and Maulid readings are stored on the phone, so they still open at a gathering where the signal is bad.
home.suite_title: What we use ourselves at work.
home.suite_desc: Product Suite is an internal toolkit for testing payment flows from one place — from simulating transactions to checking integrations before a release. It was built for the team’s day-to-day work, not as a public app.
home.suite_note: Access is limited to team members. It is not available to download or sign up for.
home.ruang_label: FROM THE YASIN TAHLIL NU APP
home.ruang_desc: Readings on the virtues of Yasin and Tahlil, the Maulid books, NU tradition and Al-Hikam — the same Ruang Ilmu you find inside the app, readable right here. Content is in Indonesian.
home.qurandiscovery_desc: Find a Quran verse by listening to recitation. Read with translation and tafsir.
home.hadithdiscovery_desc: Got a hadith forwarded to you? Paste it to see which book and number it comes from, with its grading quoted from named scholars. Offline, no account.
home.oss_title: Code we build in the open.
home.oss_desc: Beyond mobile apps, we build and maintain open-source developer tools, protocol compliance engines, and local-first software — from QRIS parsing libraries to offline Markdown notebooks for Confluence.
home.talks_title: Sharing what we know, off the screen too.
home.talks_desc: A guest-teacher session for kindergartners at <school>IAS Al-Jannah</school>: meeting the internet, learning to put the screen down, and looking after their eyes, through three play missions. Slides, guide, script and props are free to download.
home.talks_meta: 24 slides · film · 4 music tracks · printable props
home.talks_cover_alt: Illustration of children walking past a treehouse and a toy train carrying data packets
home.coming_soon: Coming soon, getting ready for release
home.sanak_desc: Build your family tree up to seven generations. Data stays on your device, with optional sync to your own Google Drive.
home.salingbantu_desc: Community crowdfunding to help pay electricity, water and internet bills for places of worship, foundations and people in need.
home.masakini_desc: Cook with what you have. Track your pantry and get meal ideas that fit your time, tools and portions. Offline, no account.

opensource.hero_lead: Developer tools, protocol parsers, and local-first utilities built by Akmal, M. and BaskomLabs. Free, open, and crafted to solve real-world development friction.
opensource.creator_bio: Crafting payment protocol parsers, local-first documentation tooling, and privacy-respecting Android apps. Everything open-source is published directly on GitHub.
opensource.conote_desc: A fast, local-first PRD & Markdown notebook for Confluence Cloud. Lets product managers and engineers draft specs offline in plain Markdown with zero editor lag, an interactive space tree, and conflict-safe publishing.
opensource.project_conote_desc: A fast, local-first PRD & Markdown notebook for Confluence Cloud. Lets product managers and engineers draft specs offline in plain Markdown with zero editor lag, an interactive space tree, and conflict-safe publishing.

opensource.qris_desc: A Python library and CLI that parses, validates and generates QRIS, following the published Bank Indonesia/ASPI v1.0 and EMVCo specifications.
opensource.project_qris_desc: Production-grade Python library, compliance auditor, dynamic generator, and CLI tool for Quick Response Code Indonesian Standard (QRIS), built strictly to Bank Indonesia, ASPI v1.0, and EMVCo standards.
opensource.qris_f1: Full recursive TLV (MPM) and Base64 BER-TLV (CPM CPV01) decoding
opensource.qris_f2: ISO/IEC 13239 CRC-16 engine with repair suggestions

opensource.kue_f1: IsoDep APDU transceiver with raw command chaining & protocol parsing
opensource.kue_f2: Multi-issuer support: Mandiri e-money, BCA Flazz, BNI TapCash, BRI Brizzi, JakCard

opensource.kue_f4: Strictly on-device & read-only: no keys stored, zero network calls
opensource.contribute_title: Got an edge case or idea?
opensource.contribute_desc: Every pull request, bug report, and architectural suggestion is welcome. Check out the source repositories on GitHub, inspect how the code works, and contribute.

pembacakue.h1: Check your e-Money, e-Toll & Flazz balance by tapping your phone
pembacakue.lead: PembacaKUE reads the balance of Indonesian electronic money cards over NFC on your Android phone. Tap the card on the back of the phone and the balance appears. No login and no bank account needed.

features.title: Balance in seconds
features.desc: Tap the card on your phone's NFC area and the balance shows instantly. Handy before a toll gate, KRL, MRT, TransJakarta or a parking barrier.

features.title: Balance read out loud
features.desc: A voice announcer reads the balance for you, with Indonesian voice packs (Diva Indonesia and Wong Oslo), so you don't have to look at the screen.

features.title: Card transaction history
features.desc: See when and where your balance was deducted to keep track of travel spending (Premium).

features.title: Toll rate calculator
features.desc: Estimate the toll fare for your vehicle class before you set off.

features.title: Read-only, data stays on your phone
features.desc: Balance and history are read from the card chip and kept on your device. The app never writes to the card or changes the balance.

features.title: Dark mode
features.desc: A responsive interface with full Dark Mode support.

howto: Make sure your Android phone has NFC and that NFC is switched on in the phone's settings.
Hold your e-Money, e-Toll, Flazz, TapCash, Brizzi or JakCard against the back of the phone (the NFC area) until the balance appears.

faq.q: Can I check an e-Toll balance with my phone?
faq.a: Yes, as long as your phone has NFC. Mandiri e-Money/e-Toll is supported, as are BCA Flazz, BNI TapCash, BRI Brizzi and JakCard.
Android phones with NFC switched on. Without NFC the card cannot be read.

faq.q: Do I need to log in or enter bank details?
faq.a: No. There is no account to create and no bank credentials to enter. The balance is read straight from the card chip.

faq.q: Can it top up or change my balance?
faq.a: No. PembacaKUE only reads the card and never writes to it, so it cannot change or top up a balance.
Free on Google Play with ads. An ad-free subscription is available inside the app.

learn.label: NFC basics: why a card works just by tapping it
Inside PembacaKUE: APDU commands and how a card answers

qrstu.h1: Scan a QRIS and see what's inside before you pay
qrstu.lead: QRSTU (QRIS Reader, Scoring & Tracking Utility) reads any QRIS code and shows what is inside it: merchant name, city, amount, NNS/acquirer and every EMVCo tag. It can also read QRIS Tap over NFC.
qrstu.notice: QRSTU only reads and explains QRIS codes. It does not make payments or move money.

features.title: Scan from anywhere
features.desc: Point the camera at a QRIS (with flash for dim counters), pick an image from your gallery, share a screenshot from another app, or paste a raw QRIS string.

features.title: Read QRIS Tap (NFC)
features.desc: Switch from Scan to Tap and hold a phone running a QRIS Tap app against the back of yours. Card data stays hidden until you choose to reveal it.

features.title: QRIS MPM & CPM parser
features.desc: Decode static and dynamic QRIS MPM and CPM payloads. Validate against EMVCo/QRIS rules, fix a broken CRC, and turn a static QR into a dynamic one.

features.title: Searchable history
features.desc: Every scan is saved with date, merchant, city and amount. Search, filter by MPM, CPM, NFC Tap or compliance, and export to CSV or JSON.

features.title: Levels & leaderboard
features.desc: Earn points for every scan and evolve through 5 levels: Nubie, Aktivis Kyuris, Juragan, Konglo and Dewa QRIS.

features.title: Learning center
features.desc: Short articles on QR code basics, the history of QRIS, MPM vs CPM, QRIS Tap, security and regulation.

howto: Point the camera at the QRIS code, pick its image from your gallery, or paste the QRIS string.
Check the result: merchant name, city, amount, acquirer and the breakdown of every tag.

faq.q: Can I scan a QRIS from a screenshot or the gallery?
faq.a: Yes. Pick a QR image from your gallery or share a screenshot from another app to QRSTU.

faq.q: What is the difference between QRIS MPM and CPM?
faq.a: MPM (Merchant Presented Mode) is the QR a merchant shows for you to scan. CPM (Customer Presented Mode) is the QR your payment app shows for the merchant to scan. QRSTU reads both.
QRIS Tap is QRIS payment over NFC: the phone is tapped instead of scanned. QRSTU can read and show the tag structure from a phone running a QRIS Tap app.
No. QRSTU only reads and explains QRIS codes. It does not make payments or move money.

faq.q: Do I have to sign in?
faq.a: No. As a guest your history stays on the device. Signing in is for backing your history up to the cloud.
Every feature is free with ads. Premium removes all ads and adds a badge next to your name on the leaderboard.
